sources.title: Lenovo PSREF · ThinkPad T14 Gen 5 Intel
sources.summary: Intel Series 1 U/H platform. Two DDR5 slots support up to 64GB. Storage support reaches 2TB. Published starting weight is configuration dependent. The family includes RJ-45 Ethernet.

sources.title: Lenovo PSREF · ThinkPad T14 Gen 6 Intel
sources.summary: Arrow Lake variants have two memory slots and support 64GB; Lunar Lake variants have fixed 16GB or 32GB memory. Family weight starts at 1.38kg for black-cover, 57Wh configurations. Storage supports 2TB. RJ-45 is listed. These are platform options, not one purchase configuration.

sources.title: Lenovo PSREF · ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 13
sources.summary: V-series variants start at 986g; U/H variants start at 1006g. Memory is non-upgradable. V-series memory reaches 32GB; 64GB applies to selected non-V variants. No built-in Ethernet port. Weight depends on configuration.

sources.title: Dell · Latitude 5450 configuration specifications
sources.summary: Latitude 5450 is a 14-inch business laptop. Listed memory options reach 64GB using two 32GB DDR5 modules. Exact processor, storage, price and weight require configuration-level verification.

sources.title: HP · EliteBook 840 G11 technical brief
sources.summary: The 14-inch EliteBook 840 G11 supports Intel Core Ultra Series 1 U/H processors. Two accessible memory slots support up to 64GB. Storage options reach 2TB. It lists two Thunderbolt 4 ports, two USB-A ports and HDMI. Battery design capacity is 56Wh.

sources.title: HP Support · EliteBook 840 G11 specifications
sources.summary: HP lists a starting weight of 1.417kg for the EliteBook 840 G11. Weight depends on configuration and components. Memory options include 64GB across two DDR5 modules.

sources.title: ASUS India · ExpertBook P5 P5405
sources.summary: ExpertBook P5 P5405 uses Intel Core Ultra Series 2 processors with up to 32GB LPDDR5X memory. ASUS India lists weight starting at 1.27kg and two SSD slots. Regional specifications differ from the original launch announcement.

sources.title: Apple Support · MacBook Air 13-inch M4 2025
sources.summary: The M4 MacBook Air has a 13.6-inch display, 16GB base unified memory with options to 32GB, and storage options to 2TB. Published weight is 1.24kg. The 53.8Wh battery and two Thunderbolt 4 ports are specified. No RJ-45 port is listed.

sources.title: Apple · M4 MacBook Air launch, March 2025
sources.summary: Apple announced the M4 MacBook Air on March 5, 2025, with availability from March 12. US starting prices were $999 for 13-inch and $1,199 for 15-inch models. These are historical launch prices, not current quotations.

sources.title: ASUS · ExpertBook P5 launch, September 2024
sources.summary: ASUS announced ExpertBook P5 P5405 on September 4, 2024. The announcement describes a 2.5K 144Hz display and 1.29kg design. The India product page later lists a different starting weight; this is not evidence of a measured hardware change.

launches.summary: US 13-inch starting launch price of $999; availability announced for March 12, 2025.
